scope_findings.claim: FIELDWISE is an MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowship (European Postdoctoral Fellowship) hosted at Eötvös Loránd University (ELTE), Hungary, an EU Member State.
The action has a 24-month European Fellowship phase.
A 6-month non-academic sector placement (AgroVIR farmer-field / operational evaluation) is included at the end of the project, giving a 30-month total duration.

European agriculture faces an increasingly water-constrained production environment, with approximately 30% of EU territory affected by seasonal water scarcity and climate change intensifying drought and irrigation demand.
